colossians.3.p1.b1.text: Therefore, since you have been raised with Christ, strive for the things above, …

colossians.3.p1.b2.text: Set your minds on things above, not on earthly things.

colossians.3.p1.b3.text: For you died, and your life is now hidden with Christ in God.

colossians.3.p1.b4.text: When Christ, who is your life, appears, then you also will appear with Him in glory.

colossians.3.p2.b1.text: Put to death, therefore, the components of your earthly nature: sexual immorality, impurity, lust, evil desires, and greed, …

colossians.3.p2.b2.text: But now you must put aside all such things as these: anger, rage, malice, slander, and filthy language from your lips.

colossians.3.p3.b1.text: … since you have taken off the old self with its practices, and have put on the new self, …

colossians.3.p3.b2.text: Here there is no Greek or Jew, circumcised or uncircumcised, barbarian, Scythian, slave, or free, …

colossians.3.p3.b3.text: … but Christ is all and is in all.

colossians.3.p4.b1.text: Therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, clothe yourselves with hearts of compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience.

colossians.3.p4.b2.text: Bear with one another and forgive any complaint you may have against someone else.

colossians.3.p4.b3.text: And over all these virtues put on love, which is the bond of perfect unity.

colossians.3.p5.b1.text: Let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, … And be thankful.

colossians.3.p5.b2.text: … as you teach and admonish one another with all wisdom, and as you sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs with gratitude in your hearts to God.

colossians.3.p5.b3.text: And whatever you do, in word or deed, do it all in the name of the Lord Jesus, …

colossians.3.p5.b4.text: … giving thanks to God the Father through Him.

colossians.3.p6.b1.text: Wives, submit to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.

colossians.3.p6.b2.text: Husbands, love your wives and do not be harsh with them.

colossians.3.p6.b3.text: Children, obey your parents in everything, for this is pleasing to the Lord.

colossians.3.p6.b4.text: Fathers, do not provoke your children, so they will not become discouraged.

colossians.3.p7.b1.text: Slaves, obey your earthly masters in everything, … but with sincerity of heart and fear of the Lord.

colossians.3.p7.b2.text: Whatever you do, work at it with your whole being, for the Lord and not for men,

colossians.3.p7.b3.text: because you know that you will receive an inheritance from the Lord as your reward. It is the Lord Christ you are serving.

colossians.3.p7.b4.text: Whoever does wrong will be repaid for his wrong, and there is no favoritism.
